patterns.text: Breadcrumb spine replaces spatial memory. Users navigate into scopes like folders, not by panning a graph. Force-directed graph becomes secondary toggle, lazy-loaded only on demand.
Children > 0 means folder (navigate deeper), children === 0 means leaf (open detail). Single rule, no ambiguity. Cards render both with visual distinction.
Finder and Graph share the same drawer model: left = INTEL (scoped to breadcrumb level in Finder, fleet-wide in Graph), right = DETAIL on selection. No sidebar. Consistent mental model across views.
HUD elements must never overlay content. Control panel is narrow, breadcrumb bar is full-width but thin, card grid clears both with padding. No modals, no traps.
